item.title: North Korea removes 'hostile' expressions in constitution, seemingly avoiding heightening inter-Korean tensions (북, 헌법에 ‘적대적’ 표현 배제…남북 긴장 고조 피하는 듯)
item.description:
North Korea's constitutional amendment, which codifies inter-Korean relations as a 'two-state' relationship and removes all references to unification, is interpreted as announcing a path toward becoming a 'normal state' separate from the South. However, assessments suggest that by not explicitly using the term 'hostile' and refraining from specifying maritime borders, the North has also sent a message to the South that it does not intend to escalate tensions. (북한이 헌법을 개정해 남북 관계를 ‘두 국가’ 관계로 명문화하고 통일 관련 표현을 모두 삭제한 것은 남쪽과는 별개의 ‘정상 국가’로 나아가겠다는 노선을 공표한 것으로 해석된다. 다만 ‘적대적’이라는 표현은 명시하지 않고, 해상 국경을 구체화하지 않으면서 긴장을 고조시키지 않겠다는 메시지도 남쪽에 보냈다는 평가가 나온다.)

According to the content of North Korea's new constitution, disclosed at an expert briefing for the unification ministry press corps held at the Government Complex Seoul on the 6th, the North added a territorial clause in Article 2, stating that 'the territory includes the land bordering the People's Republic of China to the north and the Russian Federation to the north, and the Republic of Korea to the south, along with the territorial seas and airspace established on that basis.' It explicitly refers to South Korea as the 'Republic of Korea' and has deleted all unification-related concepts and principles, such as 'northern half' or 'fatherland unification,' from the preamble and main text, replacing inter-Korean relations with those of separate states. A notable example is the removal of the existing constitutional phrase (from the September 2023 amendment): 'strive to achieve the complete victory of socialism and realize the fatherland unification based on the principles of independence, peaceful unification, and great national unity.' (6일 정부서울청사에서 열린 통일부 기자단 대상 전문가 간담회에서 공개된 북한 새 헌법 내용을 보면, 북한은 2조에 영토 조항을 신설해 ‘영역은 북쪽으로 중화인민공화국과 로씨야(러시아)연방, 남쪽으로 대한민국과 접하고 있는 영토와 그에 기초하여 설정된 영해와 영공을 포함한다’고 규정했다. 남한을 ‘대한민국’으로 명시하고, 서문과 본문에선 ‘북반부’나 ‘조국통일’ 등 통일 관련 개념과 원칙은 모두 삭제해 남북을 개별 국가 관계로 치환했다. 기존 헌법(2023년 9월 개정)에 명시한 ‘사회주의의 완전한 승리를 이룩하며 자주, 평화통일, 민족대단결의 원칙에서 조국통일을 실현하기 위하여 투쟁한다’는 문장이 삭제된 것이 대표적이다.)

North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un, at a plenary meeting of the Workers' Party of Korea in December 2023, defined inter-Korean relations as 'hostile two-state relations' along with a anti-unification stance abandoning the national unification line. Accordingly, this constitutional amendment reflects the two-state theory. However, confrontational expressions such as 'destructive maneuvers of internal and external hostile elements' were excluded, and phrases hostile to the South like 'wartime pacification' or 'education on the number one hostile state' were also not included. (김정은 북한 국무위원장은 2023년 12월 조선노동당 전원회의에서 민족통일 노선을 폐기하는 반통일 기조와 함께 남북 관계를 ‘적대적 두 국가 관계’로 규정했다. 이에 따라 이번 헌법 개정에 두 국가론이 반영됐다. 다만 ‘내외적대분자들의 파괴책동’과 같은 대결적 표현은 배제됐고, ‘전시 평정’이나 ‘제1적대국 교양’ 등 대남 적대 문구도 담기지 않았다.)

The new constitution also did not specify the South's land and maritime boundary lines, which have been noted as potential sources of dispute. This appears to be an intention not to fuel controversy over the Northern Limit Line (NLL) in the West Sea or the Military Demarcation Line (MDL, Armistice Line) boundary standards. (새 헌법은 분쟁을 야기할 수 있다고 지적되어온 남쪽 육·해상 경계선을 구체화하지도 않았다. 서해 북방한계선(NLL)이나 군사분계선(MDL·휴전선) 경계 기준에 대한 논란을 키우지 않겠다는 의도로 보인다.)

Regarding this, analyses suggest that North Korea's hostile perception of South Korea may be managed depending on the situation. At the briefing, Lee Jeong-chul, a professor of political science and international relations at Seoul National University, said, "The absence of terms like 'hostile relations' or 'belligerent relations' gives a hopeful judgment that an infrastructure for inter-Korean peaceful coexistence could be established." Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, told The Hankyoreh, "Not specifying the maritime border in detail seems to be an intention not to fundamentally dismantle the existing armistice regime." He interpreted it as "North Korea has no intention of moving toward conflict or hostile relations, but shows a willingness to coexist under a state of mutual non-aggression." However, he added, "It is difficult to interpret the absence of 'hostile' expressions as a sign of short-term improvement in inter-Korean relations." (이를 두고 북한의 남한에 대한 적대적 인식이 상황에 따라 관리될 수 있다는 분석이 나온다. 간담회에서 이정철 서울대 정치외교학부 교수는 “적대적·교전국 관계 등의 표현이 등장하지 않는 건 남북 평화공존으로 가는 하나의 인프라가 마련될 수 있겠다는 희망적 판단도 해본다”고 말했다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 한겨레에 “해상 국경을 세부적으로 규정하지 않은 것은 기존 정전협정 체제를 근본적으로 허물지는 않겠다는 의도로 보인다”며 “북한이 분쟁이나 적대적 관계로 가겠다는 의도는 없으며, 서로 불가침 상태에서 공존하겠다는 뜻을 보인 것”으로 해석했다. 그러나 그는 “‘적대적’ 표현이 없는 것을 단기간에 남북 관계가 개선될 것으로 해석하기는 어렵다”고도 덧붙였다.)

It is also noteworthy that the achievements of the predecessors (Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il) in state-building and unification have been erased, and the authority and status of State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un have been strengthened by defining him as the 'head of state.' Lim Eul-chul, a professor at the Institute for Far Eastern Studies at Kyungnam University, interpreted this as "removing the personal elements of Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il and strengthening the character of a normal state constitution." (선대(김일성·김정일)의 국가건설과 통일업적도 모두 지우고, 김정은 국무위원장을 ‘국가수반’으로 정의하는 등 권한과 위상을 강화한 것도 눈길을 끈다. 임을출 경남대 극동문제연구소 교수는 “김일성, 김정일의 개인적 요소를 빼고 정상 국가 헌법의 성격을 강화했다”고 해석했다.)

Specifying the State Affairs Commission Chairman's authority to use nuclear weapons for the first time and establishing the basis for delegating the chairman's nuclear use authority to the nuclear force command organization reflects the incorporation of the Nuclear Force Policy Act, adopted in September 2022, into the constitution. Article 3 of the Nuclear Force Policy Act stipulates that North Korea's nuclear forces obey the command of the State Affairs Commission Chairman, and the nuclear force command organization assists the chairman throughout the entire process of nuclear weapons-related decisions. (국무위원장의 핵 사용 권한을 처음 명시하고, 핵무력지휘기구에 대한 국무위원장의 핵 사용 권한 위임 근거를 마련한 건 2022년 9월 채택한 핵무력정책법 규정을 헌법에 반영한 것이기도 하다. 핵무력정책법 3조는 북한의 핵무력은 국무위원장의 지휘에 복종하고, 핵무력지휘기구가 핵무기 관련 결정 전 과정에서 국무위원장을 보좌하도록 규정했다.)

item.title: Ruling and opposition parties narrowing gap in battlegrounds… Did the special counsel probe on alleged ‘fabricated indictment’ consolidate conservatives? (여야, 격전지 격차 좁혀져…조작기소 특검법, 보수 결집 이끌었나)
item.description:
The approval rating gap between ruling and opposition candidates is gradually narrowing in key battlegrounds for the June 3 local elections. An analysis suggests that the conservative base has consolidated since the Democratic Party’s push for a special counsel investigation into the alleged ‘fabricated indictment’ on the 30th of last month, shaking up the electoral landscape. On the 6th, the Democratic Party sought to minimize the fallout by stating its position regarding the timing, procedure, and content of the special counsel bill, saying, “We will decide after the local elections” (floor leader Han Byeong-do). <<> In the key election battlegrounds of Seoul, Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam, and Daegu, opinion poll results are showing the approval rating gap narrowing. According to a poll commissioned by *Gyeongnam Shinmun* and conducted by Monocommunications and Monoresearch on the 1st-2nd using an automated wireless response method, Kim Gyeong-soo, the Democratic Party candidate for Gyeongnam Governor, received 41.9% support, while Park Wan-soo, the People Power Party candidate, garnered 44.1%. Compared to a previous poll commissioned by MBC Gyeongnam and conducted by KSOI on the 20th-21st of last month, also via automated wireless response (Kim 46.9%, Park 35.7%), the race has become much tighter. Kim previously held an 11.2 percentage point lead, but recent surveys show the advantage has shifted. <<> The Daegu mayoral election is also a close contest. In a survey commissioned by Daegu MBC and conducted by Ace Research on the 2nd-3rd using automated wireless responses, Democratic candidate Kim Bu-gyeom received 45.9% support, while People Power Party candidate Choo Kyung-ho received 42.4%. In a telephone interview poll commissioned by KBS and conducted by Korea Research on the 27th-29th of last month, Kim had 38.4% and Choo 31.2%, but Choo’s support appears to have accelerated since his nomination was confirmed. <<> The Seoul and Busan mayoral races are also neck-and-neck. In a telephone interview survey commissioned by SBS and conducted by Ipsos on the 1st-3rd, Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, received 41.5% support, leading Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate (33.9%), outside the margin of error (±3.5 percentage points). The gap has narrowed compared to a previous CBS-KSOI automated wireless response survey released two weeks prior (a 10.2 percentage point difference). In a Busan MBC-commissioned poll by Hanil Research on the 1st-2nd using automated wireless responses, Democratic Party Busan Mayor candidate Jeon Jae-su received 46.9% support, while People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon received 40.7%, tightening from the 14 percentage point gap seen in an MBC-commissioned poll by Korea Research Center on the 28th-29th of last month. (For details, refer to the website of the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Deliberation Committee.) <<> Although results may vary depending on survey methods and whether questions were repeated, analysis within and outside the parties suggests that the introduction of the special counsel bill on the alleged fabricated indictment may have influenced the electoral dynamics in these regions. At a time when conservative consolidation was gaining momentum after the election lineups were finalized, this is said to have provided a reason for some centrist voters to waver. <<> A party official assisting in the Yeongnam region elections told *The Hankyoreh* on the 6th, “The National Assembly special committee didn’t attract much public attention, but with the intermediate process omitted and only the resulting special counsel bill heavily spotlighted, couldn’t it inevitably amplify the backlash of ‘they’re doing as they please now that they’ve got power’?” Kim Bong-shin, CEO of the polling agency Metavoice, also noted, “The special counsel on the fabricated indictment could provide a reason for those in TK (Daegu, Gyeongbuk) and PK (Busan, Gyeongnam), who are conservative-leaning or were hesitant to vote due to disappointment with the PPP, to go to the polls.” <<> The opposition’s continued offensive against the government, using the special counsel bill as a linchpin, is also a burden. A lawmaker assisting in the Yeongnam elections said, “The goal is to downplay the issue as much as possible while shifting the focus of the campaign toward local candidates.” Another party official added, “Even the message that the special counsel push will be postponed until after the election should be handled with restraint.” <<> Reporter Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거 격전지를 중심으로 여야 후보 간 지지율 격차가 점차 줄어들고 있다. 지난달 30일 더불어민주당의 ‘조작기소 특검법’ 추진을 계기로 보수층이 결집하며 판세가 출렁이고 있다는 분석이 나온다. 민주당은 6일 특검법안의 처리 시기와 절차, 내용과 관련해 “지방선거 이후 판단하겠다”(한병도 원내대표)는 입장을 내며 파장을 최소화하려 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Calls Opponents "Advocates of Illegal Martial Law"… Pressures People Power Party Ahead of Constitutional Vote (“불법계엄 옹호론자” 거론한 이 대통령…개헌 표결 앞두고 국힘 압박)
item.description:
With the constitutional amendment vote just one day away, President Lee Jae-myung strongly urged the People Power Party (PPP) to participate in the revision on the 6th, saying, "Shouldn't we consider those who oppose (the revision) as 'advocates of illegal martial law'?" (이재명 대통령이 헌법 개정안 표결을 하루 앞둔 6일 “(개헌에) 반대하는 사람들은 ‘불법계엄 옹호론자’라고 봐야 되지 않겠냐”며 국민의힘을 향해 개헌 동참을 강하게 촉구했다.)

At a cabinet meeting combined with an emergency economic review session held at the presidential office, President Lee stated, "What citizen would oppose preventing illegal martial law and strengthening parliamentary control?" He added, "This is an opportunity that has been created after a long time. I hope everyone agrees, and that tomorrow we can put into practice what all political circles have unanimously spoken about." Referring to the inclusion of the spirit of the May 18 Democratic Uprising and the Busan-Masan Democratic Movement in the constitution, he said, "Both the ruling and opposition parties have publicly said we should include it. Why would anyone oppose that?" ( 이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의에서 “불법계엄을 더 이상 못 하게 하고, 국회의 통제를 강화하는 걸 어떤 국민이 반대하겠냐”며 “오랜만에 만들어진 기회인데 모든 국민이 동의하고, 모든 정치권이 이구동성으로 말해온 것을 내일 실천하면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 5·18 민주화운동과 부마민주항쟁 정신의 헌법 수록을 언급하며 “여당, 야당 할 것 없이 공개적으로 다들 (헌법에 넣자고) 얘기한다. 그걸 왜 반대하느냐”고도 했다.)

The constitutional amendment bill set for a plenary session vote at the National Assembly on the 7th includes: △ introduction of parliamentary approval for the president's declaration of emergency martial law, △ upgrading the National Assembly's right to request the lifting of martial law to a right to lift it, △ inclusion of the spirit of the Busan-Masan Democratic Movement and the May 18 Democratic Uprising in the preamble of the constitution, and △ stipulating the obligation of balanced regional development. Six political parties—the Democratic Party of Korea, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the New Reform Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party, excluding the PPP—jointly proposed the amendment on the 3rd of last month. <<> President Lee also said on the 2nd of last month, during a meeting with the leadership of both the ruling and opposition parties, including National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, and PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk, ahead of his parliamentary address, "I hope we can move forward with whatever is possible within this opportunity." <<> For the constitutional amendment to pass the plenary session, it needs the approval of at least 191 lawmakers, a two-thirds majority of the 300-seat parliament. This requires at least 12 votes from PPP lawmakers, but the PPP opposes the amendment as party policy. <<> National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik and the Democratic Party also urged the PPP to participate in the vote on the amendment. <<> Speaker Woo visited PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk at the PPP's party leadership office to persuade him. Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae also said, "While they don't oppose the content of the amendment, the PPP's stance that it is a hasty revision ahead of the election is truly an opposition for the sake of opposition," and urged PPP lawmakers, "Please vote according to your conscience." <<> However, after meeting with Speaker Woo, leader Jang told reporters, "I clearly stated that the party's policy is to oppose the constitutional amendment." He added, "It is unacceptable to talk about constitutional revision while engaging in unconstitutional acts like the special counsel probe for the annulment of (President Lee's) indictment." <<> The PPP decided to hold a general meeting of lawmakers and issue a statement signed by all its members arguing that the constitutional amendment is unjust. Senior Deputy Floor Leader Yoo Sang-bum said, "The majority of lawmakers believe it is inappropriate to participate in the vote," suggesting the party's possible absence from the vote. Meanwhile, PPP lawmaker Han Ji-ah, who has expressed support for the amendment, said, "I will participate in the vote as a constitutional institution." <<> Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr ( 7일 국회 본회의에 오르는 개헌안에는 △대통령의 비상계엄 선포에 대한 국회 승인권 도입 △국회 계엄해제요구권을 계엄해제권으로 격상 △부마민주항쟁 및 5·18 민주화운동 정신의 헌법 전문 수록 △지역균형발전 의무 명시 등이 담겨 있다. 국민의힘을 뺀 더불어민주당, 조국혁신당, 진보당, 개혁신당, 기본소득당, 사회민주당 등 6개 정당은 지난달 3일 개헌안을 공동발의했다.)

item.title: North Korea's Constitutional Revision Adds Territorial Clause, Removes Unification... 'Two States' Approach (영토 조항 넣고 통일은 없애고…북 ‘두 국가’ 개헌)
item.description:
North Korea was confirmed on the 6th to have added a territorial clause to its constitution, revised in March, while removing provisions related to unification. Although the term 'hostile' was not included, the revision reflects the shift in inter-Korean relations to a 'two states' relationship, as previously proclaimed by North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un. (북한이 지난 3월 개정한 헌법에 영토 조항을 신설하고, 통일 관련 조항은 삭제한 것으로 6일 확인됐다. ‘적대적’이라는 표현은 담기지 않았지만, 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 공언해온 대로 남북 관계를 ‘두 국가’ 관계로 바꾸는 내용이 반영됐다.)

According to the full text of North Korea's constitution disclosed at an expert briefing for the unification ministry's press corps held at the Government Seoul Complex on the same day, Article 2 now includes a new territorial clause. Article 2 states: 'The territory of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea includes the land bordering the People's Republic of China and the Russian Federation to the north and the Republic of Korea to the south, along with the territorial waters and airspace established based on this.' However, it does not specifically delineate land or maritime boundaries. This appears to reflect a desire not to escalate tensions, such as over the Northern Limit Line (NLL), the inter-Korean maritime border. (이날 정부서울청사에서 열린 통일부 기자단 대상 전문가 간담회에서 공개된 북한 헌법 전문을 보면, 2조에 영토 조항이 신설됐다. 2조는 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국 영역은 북쪽으로 중화인민공화국과 러시아 연방, 남쪽으로 대한민국과 접하고 있는 영토와 그에 기초하여 설정된 영해와 영공을 포함한다’고 돼 있다. 다만 육·해상 경계선을 구체적으로 규정하지는 않았다. 남북 해상 분계선인 북방한계선(NLL) 등에서 긴장 고조를 바라지 않는다는 의도를 담은 것으로 보인다.)

Furthermore, terms related to kinship or unification, such as 'northern half,' 'fatherland unification,' and 'complete victory of socialism,' have been entirely removed from both the preamble and the main text of the revised constitution. The achievements of former leaders Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il were also reduced, with all references to the unification cause omitted from the preamble. (아울러 개정 헌법 서문과 본문에선 ‘북반부’ ‘조국통일’ ‘사회주의의 완전한 승리’ 등 동족 관계나 통일과 관련한 개념이 모두 사라졌다. 김일성 주석과 김정일 국방위원장 등 선대 업적을 덜어내면서 서문의 통일 위업 기술을 모두 뺐다.)

North Korea did not include the term 'hostile' in the constitution, despite Chairman Kim Jong-un's mention of 'hostile two states.' Lee Jung-chul, a professor at Seoul National University who analyzed the full text of the North Korean constitution, said, 'While a territorial clause was added to emphasize statehood, expressions like hostile relations or belligerent relations do not appear.' (북한은 김정은 위원장이 언급한 ‘적대적 두 국가’에서 ‘적대적’이란 표현은 헌법에 담지 않았다. 북한 헌법 전문을 분석한 이정철 서울대학교 교수는 “영토 조항을 신설해 국가성을 강조했지만 적대적 관계, 교전국 관계 등의 표현은 등장하지 않는다”고 말했다.)

The status and authority of Chairman Kim Jong-un were significantly strengthened, including defining the chairman of the State Affairs Commission as the 'head of state.' For the first time, the right to use nuclear weapons was explicitly stated: 'Command over nuclear forces rests with the Chairman of the State Affairs Commission of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea.' North Korea revised its constitution with such content during the first session of the 15th Supreme People's Assembly held in March. (국무위원장을 ‘국가수반’으로 정의하는 등 김정은 위원장의 위상과 권한은 크게 강화했다. “핵무력에 대한 지휘권은 조선민주주의인민공화국 국무위원회 위원장에게 있다”는 핵 사용 권한도 처음으로 명시했다. 북한은 지난 3월 연 최고인민회의 제15기 제1차 회의에서 이런 내용으로 헌법을 개정했다.)

By Jang Ye-ji, reporter, and Park Min-hee, senior reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자, 박민희 선임기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: What Fate Awaits the Special Counsel for Manipulative Indictments?… Key Summary of the 'Dismissal Controversy' [Gongdeok Pocha] (조작기소 특검의 운명은?…‘공소취소 논란’ 핵심정리 [공덕포차])
item.description:
The controversy surrounding the 'Special Counsel Act for Investigating Manipulative Indictments by the Yoon Seok-yeol Administration' (Manipulative Indictment Special Counsel Act) proposed by the Democratic Party of Korea shows no signs of abating. In particular, the People Power Party is launching a full-scale offensive over the clause granting the special counsel the authority to dismiss charges. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 6th, "This local election will be one that judges the criminal organization that is the Democratic Party of Korea and its ringleader, Lee Jae-myung," adding, "They are currently destroying all constitutional and judicial order. Lee Jae-myung is the destroyer-in-chief and the ringleader," raising his voice. (더불어민주당이 발의한 ‘윤석열 정권 조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’(조작기소 특검법)을 둘러싼 논란이 수그러들지 않고 있습니다. 특히 특검에 공소취소 권한을 부여한 내용을 두고 국민의힘에서 총공세를 펼치고 있는데요. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 6일 “이번 지방선거는 범죄단체인 더불어민주당과 그 수괴인 이재명을 심판하는 선거가 될 것”이라며 “지금 모든 헌법 질서와 사법 질서를 파괴하고 있다. 이재명이 그 파괴왕이고 수괴”라고 목소리를 높였습니다.)

Within the Democratic Party, voices of concern are also emerging, mainly from local election candidates. Woo Sang-ho, a Democratic Party candidate for Gangwon Province governor and former senior presidential secretary for political affairs, said in a radio interview that day, "I don't see why we need to bring this up and ignite a debate during such an important election period," adding, "Whether to handle this through a special counsel or some other method should be decided through internal party discussions after the local elections." (민주당 안에서도 지방선거 출마자들을 중심으로 우려의 목소리가 나오는데요. 청와대 정무수석을 지낸 우상호 민주당 강원도지사 후보는 이날 라디오 인터뷰에서 “굳이 이걸 중요한 선거 시기에 꺼내서 발의하고 논쟁을 삼는 이유를 모르겠다”며 “이걸 특검 방식으로 하느냐, 다른 방식으로 하느냐는 지방선거 이후 당내 논의를 거쳐 결정해야 한다”고 말했습니다.)

Who was behind granting the power to dismiss charges to the Manipulative Indictment Special Counsel? How will the dismissal controversy affect this local election? Will the constitutional amendment enshrining the May 18 Democratization Movement pass the National Assembly plenary session? On the 6th, features Lee Choon-jae, an editorial writer for The Hankyoreh, to delve into the details of the dismissal controversy. Check out the video! (조작기소 특검에 공소취소 권리를 부여한 것은 누구의 의지였을까요? 공소취소 논란은 이번 지방선거에 어떤 영향을 미칠까요? 5·18 민주화운동이 새겨진 헌법 개정안은 국회 본회의를 통과할 수 있을까요? 6일 <공덕포차>에서는 이춘재 한겨레 논설위원이 출연해 공소취소 논란에 대해 자세히 알아봅니다. 영상으로 확인하시죠!)

item.title: President Lee: "High Suicide Rate Is a Shame Unbefitting Our Status" (이 대통령 “높은 자살률, 우리 위상에 이런 망신도 없다”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 6th described South Korea's high suicide rate as "a global shame that doesn't match our position" and ordered efforts to bolster suicide prevention measures. (이재명 대통령이 6일 우리나라의 높은 자살률에 대해 “전 세계적으로 이런 망신도 없다”며 자살예방 대책에 힘을 쏟으라고 지시했다.)

After receiving a report from the Office for Government Policy Coordination and other agencies on the current status and future plans for suicide prevention at a Cabinet meeting held at the Blue House, President Lee stated, "Given South Korea's current standing, it's unacceptable to have such a high number of suicides." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 국무조정실 등으로부터 자살예방대책 추진현황 및 향후 계획을 보고받은 뒤 “현재 대한민국 위상으로 보건대 이렇게 자살자가 많다는 것은 말이 안 된다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

President Lee remarked, "It's incredibly cruel for someone to end their own life due to external factors after being born," and instructed, "This is a critical national issue, so make sure to personally check what local governments and relevant agencies are doing." (이 대통령은 “누군가 태어나 외부 요인 때문에 인생을 스스로 그만둔다는 건 너무나 잔인한 일”이라며 “중요 국가 과제이니 지방정부와 관계기관이 어떻게 하고 있는지 직접 챙겨보라”고 지시했다.)

Inquiring whether the system for managing depression patients is adequately in place, President Lee said, "I have my own personal pain and experiences," adding, "In the mental health field, based on my experience, the administration barely functions and leaves everything to individuals, sometimes leading to tragic outcomes." (이 대통령은 우울증 환자 관리 시스템이 충분히 갖춰져 있는지를 물으며 “제가 개인적인 아픔, 경험도 있다”며 “정신보건 분야에 대해서는 제 경험으로 (행정이) 거의 작동하지 않고 개인에게 맡겨져 있어 슬픈 결과를 만들기도 한다”고 했다.)

President Lee also referenced his experience of being indicted and tried for allegedly instructing a health center director to hospitalize his older brother in a psychiatric hospital in June 2012, during his tenure as Seongnam Mayor, and for making false statements about this during a TV debate ahead of the 2018 local elections, pointing out flaws in the system. (이 대통령은 또한 성남시장 재임 시절 2012년 6월 보건소장 등에게 친형을 정신병원에 입원시키도록 지시하고 2018년 지방선거 전 티브이(TV)토론회에서 이를 사실과 다르게 말했다는 혐의로 기소돼 재판을 받은 경험을 언급하며 제도의 맹점을 지적하기도 했다.)

President Lee said, "The law allows for compulsory diagnosis and treatment opportunities, but doing so leads to backlash and resistance, creating social problems," and added, "It would be good to discuss government policies in the mental health sector separately." He stated, "There is a response system in the law, but I gave up trying to apply that system and ended up facing several years of trial because of it. It's absurd." President Lee also said, "If you get indicted and tried for something like abuse of authority, who would want to try it?" (이 대통령은 “법률로는 강제적으로 진단하고 치료 기회를 부여할 수 있게 돼 있기는 한데 그걸 하면 반발, 저항해 사회문제가 된다”며 “정신보건 분야 정부 정책을 별도로 논의하면 좋겠다”고 했다. 그는 “법에 나름의 대응 시스템이 있는데 내가 그 법에 있는 대응 시스템을 적용하려다 포기한 것 때문에 재판을 몇 년 받았다. 황당무계하다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “무슨 직권남용이라고 기소해서 재판하는 이런 짓을 하니 누가 하려고 하겠느냐”고도 했다.)

Upon receiving a report that suicide prevention hotline staffing falls short of the quota due to budget shortages, President Lee said, "What if we just increase it to at least 100% of the quota?" He then suggested, "For now, try to get temporary private support," before laughing and adding, "I'm not sure if this might get me caught for third-party bribery." (이 대통령은 자살예방 상담 전화 인력이 예산 부족으로 정원에 미달한다는 보고를 받고 “최소 (정원의) 100%로 확 늘려주면 어떨까”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “일단은 임시로 민간 지원을 받아보라”고 했다가 “이러다 제3자 뇌물죄로 걸리는 것 아닌지 모르겠다”고 언급하며 웃었다.)
